name: smwmusic-suzuka
title: Suzuka 8 Hours - Main Menu
description:
This is the Main Menu theme from Suzuka 8 Hours. Since Decoy did a port of this game by my request, it's only natural I also make my own port of this game's soundtrack haha

This one could fit overworlds and some other small places, but be careful with using this for a level because it's a very short and repetitive song, so unless it's either a small section or just a small level in general, I advise against using it for levels. You can still do it tho, it's up to you really ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
